jobs.description:
What We’re All About.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

What you’ll bring.

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence

  • Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.

  • Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap aligned to business objectives, operational efficiency, governance requirements and future compliance needs, including SOX readiness.

  • Analyse and redesign finance processes to improve productivity, control effectiveness and user experience.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies, developing practical and prioritised remediation plans.

  • Establish robust data governance, validation and reporting frameworks to improve the quality, consistency and reliability of financial information.

  • Map and optimise end-to-end transaction flows across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Support the creation of scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide meaningful operational and financial insight.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Lead finance systems and automation projects from initial requirements through to implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.

  • Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate, select and implement solutions that support future-state finance operations.

  • Drive automation opportunities across close processes, journal management, reconciliations, variance analysis and reporting.

  • Ensure data integrity, auditability and control considerations are embedded within all system and process changes.

  • Establish governance standards for financial data, system ownership and ongoing process maintenance.

Programme Delivery & Change Management

  • Apply disciplined project and programme management practices including planning, risk management, benefits tracking, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.

  • Define success measures and ensure transformation benefits are tracked, validated and sustained over time.

  • Build engagement and buy-in across the finance organisation by clearly communicating objectives, priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Support teams through process, technology and organisational change, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working.

  • Translate complex finance, operational and technology challenges into clear and actionable implementation plans.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Legal, Operations and commercial functions to align transformation priorities with wider business objectives.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on finance process, controls, systems and operating model design.

  • Work alongside finance teams to resolve complex operational challenges, improve processes and implement best practices.

  • Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on programme progress, risks, benefits realisation and key transformation milestones.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the finance function.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential.

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ICAS, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience operating at Head of Finance / Financial Controller level, with broad oversight of the full accounting cycle (AP through to management accounts).

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-GAAP statutory accounting across multiple entities/jurisdictions.

  • Deep understanding of controllership processes: financial close cycles, account reconciliation, consolidation, intercompany accounting, journal entry management, and statutory reporting.

  • Track record of successfully leading financial systems/process implementation projects (e.g. ERP implementation, close process redesign, close automation tooling).

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement future-state close operating models covering process, automation, controls, data, and people.

  • Strong project management skills and experience, ideally with formal methodology exposure (e.g. Agile, Prince2, or similar).

  • Experience leading teams through significant change, with a genuine ability to bring people along on the journey.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented while also operating strategically.

Desirable.

  • Hands-on implementation or advisory experience with one or more close automation or EPM platforms (e.g. FloQast, BlackLine, OneStream, Prophix, or comparable).

  • Experience in a fast-growing, multi-entity, international business (SaaS/technology sector a plus).

  • Experience with modern finance/ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and reporting/automation tools.

  • Familiarity with the intersection between close quality, internal controls, and external audit.

  • Prior experience partnering with Legal, HR, and commercial teams on cross-functional finance matters.

  • PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification, or a Lean Six Sigma qualification.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

jobs.title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist.

This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build.

What You'll Build

  • Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments.

  • Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations.

  • Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models.

  • Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms.

  • Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance.

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing.

  • Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads.

  • Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust.

  • Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Callosum believes that the next generation of AI systems will emerge from models and hardware being optimised together. Today's model architectures have largely evolved around the capabilities of conventional GPUs, leaving significant opportunities unexplored as new accelerator architectures emerge. We are building infrastructure that allows models to be adapted to different computational substrates, rather than treating them as fixed algorithms that hardware must accommodate.

This role explores how model architectures and inference algorithms can be adapted to exploit heterogeneous hardware, creating specialised variants with different trade-offs between capability, latency, and cost. You will investigate transformations spanning numerics, sparsity, model structure, memory, and execution, alongside new algorithms designed around emerging accelerators. A central part of the work is developing automated approaches to these adaptations and rigorous evaluations that establish when the resulting models offer meaningful advantages.

What You'll Build

  • Develop hardware-aware transformations that adapt models to different accelerator architectures and execution environments.

  • Explore numerical, structural, and memory-related optimisations to create model variants with different capability, latency, and cost trade-offs.

  • Investigate new inference algorithms, including speculative decoding, designed to exploit heterogeneous computational resources.

  • Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants.

  • Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations.

What Sets You Apart

  • Deep understanding of modern LLM architectures, including attention mechanisms, model structure, and their implications for inference.

  • Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning.

  • Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms.

  • Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency.

  • Experience designing rigorous experiments to assess model quality, efficiency, and the effects of architectural modifications.

How We Work

Consumer Insights & Strategy Director

The team

We bring together different research disciplines and synthesize insights from across data sources, to tell coherent customer stories and ground decisions in evidence across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams. (Norton, Avast, MoneyLion & LifeLock)

Role summary

The Consumer Insights & Strategy Director is a senior individual contributor who acts as a strategic advisor to segment and brand leadership for either Cyber Safety (Norton & Avast) and Trust-based Solutions (LifeLock & MoneyLion).

Their primary responsibility is not to generate research, but to help the business make better decisions. They connect customer understanding, market dynamics, competitive context and commercial performance to shape growth strategy, portfolio choices, proposition development and customer experience priorities.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, customer insight and stakeholder leadership. You will:

  • Sit as a virtual member of the segment/brand leadership team, bringing the voice of the customer into key decisions.

  • Synthesize diverse inputs into clear, actionable narratives that influence direction.

  • Shape and prioritise the learning agenda for your segment in partnership with the wider Insight team.

  • Proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders on major strategic or commercial decisions (e.g., portfolio strategy, brand positioning, proposition development, experience design, go-to-market).

  • Experience synthesising multiple data and insight sources (qual, quant, analytics, CX, market intel) into concise, decision-ready outputs.

  • Demonstrated impact in turning insight into action - influencing real changes in products, experiences, communications or commercial strategy.

Skills & capabilities

  • Strategic, structured thinker - able to frame problems, prioritise questions, and connect customer insight to business outcomes.

  • Strong storytelling and communication - comfortable simplifying complexity, building clear narratives and presenting confidently to senior audiences.

  • Commercially astute - understands how brands grow, how P&Ls work, and how customer behaviour shows up in performance metrics.

  • Collaborative and credible - able to work effectively across teams, building trust and alignment in a matrix environment.

jobs.description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What We Do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Account Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets - Working towards daily, weekly and monthly targets and finalize all sales in a timely manner.

  • Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.

  • CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.

  • Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.

  • Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

What you have...

  • Experience in Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) sales

  • Fluent in German (min. C2)

  • Professional proficiency in English

  • A confident phone presence, fearlessness in leading meetings with prospects, and great listening skills

  • Strong communication skills professionally with customers, in writing and over the phone

  • Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best

  • Growth mindset - openness to feedback and coaching

  • Please send us your CV in English!

Our Perks & Benefits…

  • Remote setup

  • Equity packages for you to share in SiteMinder's growth and successes

  • Investment in your personal growth

  • Uncapped commission that rewards overachievement

  • Excellence-driven, collaborative culture

  • Well-being initiatives

  • Referral bonus for bringing in new talent

  • Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

  • Paid birthday, study and volunteering days off every year

  • Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

Does this job sound like you? If yes, we'd love for you to be part of our team! Please send a copy of your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

jobs.title: (Senior) Design System Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

 

Your tasks:

  • Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system.

  • Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships.

  • Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out.

  • Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths.

  • Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought.

  • Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes.

What you offer us:

  • Several years as a frontend or mobile engineer, including hands-on ownership of a design system or shared component library used by multiple teams.

  • TypeScript and Angular skills or comparable depth in another modern framework / library and a clear willingness to go all in on Angular plus a sharp instinct for component API design.

  • Hands-on native UI development with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose or Swift/SwiftUI. You will author native components yourself. Strong expertise in one platform, combined with an interest in developing a working knowledge of the other, is perfectly fine.

  • Experience with design tokens and theming multi-brand environments: building one system that carries several brands without forking.

  • A strong grasp of responsive and adaptive design and of accessibility standards, and the habit of verifying both in practice.

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling, you treat the design system and component libraries as a product with users and measure success by adoption. You enjoy enabling other teams and building consensus across engineering and design.

What we offer:

  • State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/)

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

  • Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

  • Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

  • Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

 

Sounds exciting? Great! We're looking forward to receiving your online application.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede
jobs.description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede 

 

Wat ga je doen? 
Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. 

Je houdt je bezig met: 

  • Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;  

  • Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; 

  • Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); 

  • Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; 

  • Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? 

 

Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. 

Dit is jouw team

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam


Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

 

Dit breng je mee 

  • Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; 

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter!

Heb je nog overige vragen? Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Sanne Jonk via 06 34955966 of  

Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

jobs.title: Industrial Data & Solutions Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

What we're building

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that helps production engineers and operators turn machine data into answers: why a line is slowing down, what's causing scrap, and what to fix next. We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding core team.

Your role & responsibility

You're the person who makes our product work in the real world. You go into a plant, figure out what's actually broken, connect the data, and stay until operators use the product every day without being asked. You'll work with everyone from the machine operator to the plant manager, and with IT and OT. You own each customer from the first conversation through rollout and expansion. Berlin or home-based in Germany, with regular time in Berlin with the team. You'll spend about 20% of your time at customer sites.

What you'll do

  • Own deployments end to end: use-case definition, data onboarding, validation, rollout, training, and adoption

  • Turn messy production problems into clear data, analytics, and solution requirements

  • Onboard and validate machine, process, quality, and maintenance data from industrial systems

  • Spot data problems that only make sense if you understand the machine behind them

  • Build and validate KPIs, features, anomaly signals, calibration methods, and analytical workflows in Python and SQL, using statistics and time-series analysis

  • Run the project with the customer and our commercial lead: plans, workshops, validation sessions, and success criteria

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics

  • Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step

  • Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together

  • Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side

  • Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be

  • Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps

  • Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost

  • Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping

  • Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion

What You´ll Bring

  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast

  • Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production

  • Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one

  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to

  • Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code

  • A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small

  • Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets

  • Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review

  • A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works

  • A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it

  • Good communication skills in English

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.

Your focus will be diagnosing network errors, page-loading issues, and incomplete rendering. You'll trace problems from network protocols through client-side execution, distinguish technical failures from intentional access restrictions, and turn findings into production fixes that improve content quality and efficiency at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own fetching and rendering improvements end to end, from investigation through implementation and production rollout, partnering with crawler engineers and SREs.

  • Define metrics for fetching reliability, content completeness, and error classification, and use them to prioritize improvements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in web infrastructure, browsers, CDNs, or crawling, with strong programming skills in at least one of Go, Python, Rust, or C++.

  • Deep understanding of HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3, including status semantics, caching, conditional requests, content encoding, and redirects; strong knowledge of TLS, DNS, cookies, and sessions.

  • Understanding of CDN caching and content delivery, HTTP error handling, retry backoff, and server-defined rate limits.

  • Comfort working independently when the path forward is not fully defined.

Nice to have

jobs.title: Founding Data Researcher
jobs.description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch, and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit, and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

This position is Paris, France based.

Your mission is to own the integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, at 100% industrial-grade quality, from architecture to production on the factory floor.

As Senior Robotics Engineer, you are the technical reference for robot control and robot programming in our product. Our roadmap covers static and dynamic robot control whatever the brand. You will architect and build these capabilities, integrate them end to end into Inbolt Studio, and make sure they run reliably on real robots in demanding production environments.

You will work at the intersection of robotics, 3D perception, and software engineering, in a small fast growing team where your contribution is visible and your decisions shape the product. This is not an R&D position: your work has a daily impact on what runs in production at Inbolt customers.

Want to take your robotics career to the next level by building the future of robot vision guidance in the real world? This role is for you.

Additional Plus

Position details

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform Core

Location: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, Permanent

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

About the Role:

At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.

We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.

This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.

If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.

  • Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.

  • Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.

  • Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.

  • Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 3 months:

  • Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.

  • Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.

By 6 months:

  • Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.

  • Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.

  • Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.

By 12 months:

  • Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.

  • Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.

  • Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.

  • An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.

  • Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.

  • Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.

  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.

  • A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.

  • Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.

  • Familiarity with API-first product architectures.

  • An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built primarily in Golang, following a modular, hexagonal architecture.

Our wider stack includes:

  • Backend: Go (Golang)

  • Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

  • Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana

You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our process straightforward, transparent, and focused on getting to know each other.

  1. Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  2. CTO & VP Engineering Interview (60 minutes): A conversation about your experience, the role, and a technical discussion based on a real experiment.

  3. Technical Assessment: A take-home exercise completed in your own time, followed by a review and discussion.

  4. Team & Culture Interview: Meet with a member of the team to learn more about how we work together and ensure there's a strong mutual fit.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : Senior Product Manager

Contrat : CDI

À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir.

Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais.À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez :

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

  • Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

  • Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

  • Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

  • Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez :

Critères essentiels :

  • Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

  • Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

  • De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

  • Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

  • Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité technique et de marché à des interlocuteurs variés, clients compris, ainsi qu’une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (ingénierie, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery, etc.) pour livrer des solutions localisées

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie en France : vous connaissez le fonctionnement du marché et ses acteurs clés (ex. Enedis / GRDF), notamment sur les données d’équipements et les flux de marché

  • Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de l’énergie ou de services publics (utilities) sur le marché français

  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

 

Nos avantages

 

  • Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

  • Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes

 

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

You will join the Data layer of Oxa Driver: the teams that train, teach and test the machine-learning systems our vehicles rely on. They turn data from our vehicles and simulation into the datasets, scenarios and tools the rest of the stack builds on, and their workload grows with each new operating domain and site we take on.

Data is a group of teams responsible for:

  • collecting and curating real-world data, including dataset quality and labelling

  • generating synthetic sensor data to fill gaps in real-world coverage

  • simulation and digital twins of the sites our vehicles operate in

  • the data infrastructure that stores, organises and serves this data

  • applying machine learning to hard problems across the stack

The teams work closely with Autonomy Applications, who train and deploy models on this data, Integration & Test, our data ingest and platform teams, our safety team, and the Solutions team who take our products to customers.

Your Role:

Our Technical Program Manager is the delivery enabler for the Data teams. They coordinate delivery so the teams can collect, curate, generate and ship data with less friction, and their leads can focus on engineering.

They will work with engineering, product and solutions leaders across the stack who own customer outcomes. The focus of the Program Manager is to make sure the datasets, simulations and tools other teams depend on arrive when planned, with risks and dependencies visible early.

This role will be based in our Oxford office, with occasional visits to our vehicle sites to support understanding of how data is collected and used.

 
 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Take the layer's commitments in our product engineering plan and, with the leads, turn them into sequenced work with dates and a clear definition of done. Bring the teams' planning into Jira in a way that adds little overhead, and keep work traceable to the products it supports.

  • Run the regular triage of data-quality issues that affect model training, such as calibration, timing and labelling problems. Make sure every issue has an owner, a priority and a next step.

  • Coordinate the data, scenarios and simulation each new operating site needs, so they are ready when the site goes live.

  • Run the layer's cloud cost reporting, and help leads balance cost against keeping available the data that teams need.

  • Track what the teams need from others and what others need from them, raise conflicts early and broker the trade-offs:

    • data from our vehicles and ingest pipelines

    • datasets, scenarios and simulation for model training and testing

    • external labelling and cloud compute providers

  • Report monthly progress against plan, plus data-quality and cost health. Use simple metrics, such as dataset turnaround time and cost per training cycle, to show whether delivery is improving.

  • Find the friction, such as manual curation steps, unclear ownership or slow data turnaround, and drive fixes with the teams.

What you need to succeed:

  • A career that started in engineering (a degree in computer science, software, data, electrical, robotics or similar) and have moved into delivery, with 2+ years as a TPM, project engineer or delivery manager on a technical product.

  • Knowledge of the data and ML lifecycle: You know how data moves from collection through curation, labelling and dataset release to model training and evaluation, and why data quality and versioning matter. Hands-on experience in data engineering, machine learning or simulation is preferred but not essential.

  • Data and cloud fluency: Enough to follow the engineering and ask good questions: data pipelines, cloud storage and compute, datasets and labelling, and simulation.

  • You break down work, map dependencies and forecast from data (using tools like Jira, Confluence and Miro), and you build trust with engineers when priorities shift.

Extra kudos if you have:

  • Experience in automotive, robotics or other autonomous systems.

  • Experience with MLOps, data platforms or labelling operations.

  • Exposure to simulation, synthetic data generation or digital twins.

  • Experience tracking or optimising cloud spend.

  • Comfort with Git-based planning, documentation-as-code, or AI tools for reporting.

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

 

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary benchmarked against the market

  • Participation in a great company equity scheme

  • Enhanced pension contributions

  • Annual holiday allowance of 25 days per year

  • Overseas working policy for up to 8 weeks per year

  • Flexible, hybrid and remote working arrangements

  • Comprehensive Private Health cover with the option to add family members,

  • Enhanced health and wellbeing benefits including health cash plan, critical illness cover, life assurance and group income protection

  • Enhanced paid maternity and paternity policy

 

If you're excited by deep technical problems, real-world AI, and the opportunity to build technology that will reshape global industry, you'll find both the challenge and the impact you're looking for at Oxa.
