jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The GTM Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across EMEA to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust.

You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in a B2B technology GTM organization across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, BDR, Enablement, frontline leadership, or a combination of these roles.

  • Experience working in a channel or partner-led GTM environment, with practical knowledge of selling with and through partners such as resellers, MSPs, distributors, and other channel partners, including partner engagement, account mapping, co-selling, and partner-led growth.

  • Experience carrying a quota, leading a frontline GTM team, or directly coaching customer-facing teams strongly preferred.

  • Strong business and analytical acumen, with demonstrated ability to diagnose performance problems, identify root causes, and turn insights into practical, measurable plans that improve skills, behaviors, and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of how to apply sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC in coaching, enablement, or field execution.

  • Credibility with frontline GTM leaders and sellers, built through curiosity, thoughtful discovery, and sound judgment, with the ability to operate independently as a coach, advisor, and constructive challenger.

  • High curiosity and fluency with AI, with experience using AI, automation, dashboards, and performance signals to make coaching more individualized, scalable, and measurable.

  • Understanding of how selling practices and customer needs vary across EMEA markets; additional language skills are helpful.

  • A bias toward action, experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

What you can expect:

  • Own the performance improvement cycle for the frontline managers and teams you support: diagnose, prescribe, activate, reinforce, measure, and adjust.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with managers, bringing data-informed insights and recommendations about where their coaching can have the greatest impact.

  • Combine business results, behavioral data, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify performance gaps and create focused development plans.

  • Create strategic enablement plans that address root causes and become part of the team’s day-to-day work.

  • Use AI-powered role-play, practice, feedback loops, manager coaching, live learning, and tools such as Hyperbound to support individualized development at scale.

  • Help managers reinforce key skills, products, messaging, partner motions, and GTM priorities through ongoing coaching and team practice.

  • Partner across Technical Enablement, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Engineering, and other teams to bring the right resources into identified performance challenges.

  • Facilitate workshops, webinars, and other learning experiences when appropriate, while enabling managers to lead reinforcement with their teams.

  • Measure whether interventions are changing behavior and improving outcomes, and share recurring performance patterns and field feedback with cross-functional partners.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £78,000 GBP and £113,000 GBP. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. jobs.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

With over 8 million signers sold worldwide, Ledger Wallet is where Ledger users manage and grow their assets. Transactional Services (buy, sell, swap, trading and stablecoin products) is its main source of service revenue.

Money Flows connects users' crypto to the fiat world in both directions: on/off-ramp, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, and the growing P2P and Payments use cases. Users buy crypto with fiat or sell it back to their bank, move cash into stablecoins, and spend crypto with a card, all through specialist partners. It is the entry and exit door of the Ledger Wallet economy and a key lever to diversify Transactional Services revenue. The role reports to the Senior Director, Transactional Services.

What you’ll be doing:

You own and grow Money Flows end to end - revenue, economics, partner ecosystem and the quality of every fiat journey in Ledger Wallet - with a General Manager mindset over a business run mostly through external partners and cross-functional teams. The ambition is to grow revenue 10x in two to three years, through a strategy and roadmap you define and turn into quantified milestones.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Business Line Ownership & Revenue Delivery: Being ultimately accountable for Money Flows revenue, volume and take rate across buy, sell, cash-to-stablecoin, Card, P2P and Payments. Building and defending the forecast, querying the data yourself, and separating market effects from the levers the team controls.

  • Monetization & Pricing: Owning take rate by line, partner and payment method. Turning volume into direct or indirect revenue (zero-fee partners, cash-to-stablecoin flows), and keeping pricing/product competitive against exchanges, neobanks and other wallets.

  • Partner Management & Business Development: Identifying, signing, managing and negotiating with the ramp, payment, stablecoin and card-issuing partner bench - on pricing, geographic and payment-method coverage, conversion, KYC friction and operational quality. Managing concentration risk, onboarding new providers to close gaps, and running a monthly review with each partner.

  • Card Programme Ownership: Running the card programme: economics, activation and dormancy, issuer and processor performance, card-scheme negotiations (including geo expansion), and the go-to-market with Marketing.

  • Ledger Wallet Experience: Working with the Product Line Manager to improve the Buy, Sell, Card and Pay journeys, and making sure every release ships with a coordinated go-to-market.

  • Stablecoin & Payments Roadmap: Shaping how Ledger captures stablecoin and payment use cases - cash-to-stablecoin, Pay and peer-to-peer flows - together with Product, within local regulatory frameworks (MiCA,...) with Legal and Compliance, informed by close tracking of the ramp, stablecoin and card landscape.

  • Operational Excellence & Observability: Partner SLAs, incident management and fast action to protect users, Ledger and revenue; conversion, failed-payment and KYC-drop monitoring; and closing measurement gaps so every line can be steered on data.

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Driving execution across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Pricing, Marketing/CRM and other business lines - all of it outside your reporting lines - to ship improvements, drive growth and resolve issues.

What we’re looking for:

  • Ownership mindset: A demonstrated ability to own a business line or revenue stream end to end and make data-driven decisions. You are energized by being accountable for a P&L line and delivering the budget, including in a soft market.

  • Exceptional quantitative skills: A strong track record of using data to drive decisions and manage execution. You enjoy digging into the numbers yourself and separating market effect from execution.

  • Commercial & business development experience: Proven results negotiating and managing external partners on pricing, terms and performance. You like using data and leverage to improve terms, coverage and quality, and building relationships that compound over time. Sales / business development experience is highly valued.

  • Payments industry experience (required): Experience in payments (for example at Visa, Adyen, Stripe or dLocal), with hands-on knowledge of payments and acquiring - conversion funnels, KYC, fraud and chargeback dynamics.

  • Card ecosystem: Experience in the card ecosystem - issuing, processing, card schemes or programme management, including interchange and programme economics - is a strong plus.

  • Operational excellence: Evidence of running something with rigor - managing operational risk, reducing errors and optimizing conversion or engagement. You are comfortable running live lines while shaping new ones, such as stablecoins, payments and card programs.

  • Influence in a matrixed organization: The proven ability to align Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Marketing behind your priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

  • Consumer fintech / service-revenue background: Experience in a high-volume transactional or service-revenue business is highly desirable; a B2C background is a strong plus. Fintech or equivalent service experience is a must.

  • Digital assets: Interest in stablecoins and crypto is desirable, as the crypto knowledge needed can be learned faster than payments expertise. Familiarity with MiCA and European payments regulation is a plus.

  • AI: Strong appetite for what AI can bring to analysis and operations is a must.

  • Total English fluency. The role is based in Paris; French is not a prerequisite for social or work life in our office.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now.

The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build.

The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job.

You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel.

What you'll do

Architecture above DATEV

  • Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath.

  • Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck.

  • Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read, never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project.

Reproducibility and control

  • A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers.

  • Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did (version, source, decision) and can sign off on it.

  • Build evaluation on decades of audited, completed work.

Team and scale

  • Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee.

  • Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved. You start hiring in your first quarter.

  • Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review.

Questions you'll answer

  • Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin?

  • How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility?

  • A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not?

What success looks like

  • 6 months: Architecture decided. One real use case from the core business runs in production and is used daily. Your first engineers are hired.

  • 12 months: Several agentic use cases in regular operation. The control layer holds up in a real review, and evaluation runs against closed cases, not test data.

  • 24 months: Automation is a capability of the organization, not of individuals. Every acquired firm runs on the same base, and your team ships without you in the room.

Where it leads: the full CTO mandate, a management career earned by contribution, not by years served.

What you bring

  • You have built something that ran in production and was used by people who did not build it, as founding engineer, engineering lead, technical co-founder or in a comparable role.

  • You have taken agentic systems into production and know where they break.

  • You have integrated against systems that fight back: legacy ERPs, banking backends, badly documented interfaces.

  • You write production code. AI is your everyday tool, and your position on the stack comes from what you built and threw away.

  • You work in German, because our clients and tax advisors do, and you build in person in Munich.

  • You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you.

A plus, not a requirement

  • A regulated field where mistakes have consequences: fintech, banking tech, payments (N26, Trade Republic, Solaris, Klarna, Mollie, Pleo) or software for professional services (Personio, Workato).

  • Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV.

  • No conventional CV required: a technical co-founder of a sold or failed product, or someone who can show publicly what they have built, is explicitly invited. We assess contribution, not labels. The salary range shown refers to the primary profile; a different background starts at a different market price and converges after twelve months of proven performance.

What this role is and what it isn't

  • Building, not managing. You lead engineers and stay in the code. If you want to run managers, this is the wrong role.

  • An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. IT operations, tool rollouts and the product work sit with Operations; what we build and in which order is decided together with management. You own how it is built and run.

  • In person in Munich, not a distributed team. An architecture being decided and a team finding its standards need a shared room.

Why join us

  • Turn our data into the edge. Decades of audited, completed work become the test every agent has to pass before a human sees its result.

  • Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. One decision of yours reaches several thousand clients from day one, and more with every acquisition.

  • Yours to decide. The architecture and the stack of this layer are open. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater.

  • Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team exists.

The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

We’re looking for a hands-on (Senior) Electromagnetic Development Engineer to support the development of our systems across magnetic and RF domains and other simulations, e.g. of thermal effects. Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Analyze and optimize components and system behavior, including coils, shielding, antennas, cabling, and subsystem interactions

  • Investigate electromagnetic effects on machines and assemblies during integration, testing, and operation

  • Identify and mitigate EMI/EMC, coupling, and interference issues across electrical and mechanical interfaces

  • Translate findings into concrete design improvements and provide feedback to electrical, mechanical, and system engineering

  • Support product development from design through integration, validation, and certification readiness

 

What is expected of you

  • Strong background in electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

  • Several years of hands-on experience in electromagnetic simulation and development in an industrial environment on system level

  • Good understanding of electromagnetic theory and simulation methods such as FEM, FDTD

  • Power user of simulation tools like Ansys HFSS, Maxwell, Icepak or similar

  • Practical experience with measurement, testing, and validation of electromagnetic behavior on real systems

  • Familiarity with EMI/EMC requirements

  • Experience with development processes related to CE, SEMI, UL or IEC 61010 compliance is a strong plus

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Used Cars)
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Used cars are the biggest part of the UK car market, and Carwow is going all in. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it's bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too.

We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for a vertical we are fully investing in, and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

AI changes what's possible here. A dealer shouldn't have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer; the product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Obsess over dealers:

    • Spend time with dealers: visit forecourts, sit with sales teams and learn how they buy, price and sell

    • Run your own discovery through interviews, usage data and behavioural analysis, so every decision starts from a real dealer problem

  • Set the direction and deliver:

    • Set the product direction for the partner side of Carwow Used, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Make supply effortless: get dealer stock onto Carwow with no manual effort, through feeds and integrations, stock upload and cars bought via Sell My Car listing automatically

    • Build the data products that help dealers trade profitably: what to buy, what to pay, what to price at and how fast it will sell

    • Own the success measures (live stock, time to list, cars sold, dealer retention) and bring clean evidence to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

  • Build with AI:

    • Identify, prototype and ship AI that does the work for dealers: automated listings, pricing guidance, demand matching and buyer follow-up

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Lead the team around you:

    • Lead a product trio with engineering and design: shape dealer journeys, test them before build, and make the right calls on data quality, integrations and build versus buy

    • Align data, commercial and account management on priorities, and explain strategy and trade-offs clearly in writing and in person

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a marketplace, B2B or supply-side product, with evidence of moving supply, conversion or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews with business customers, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses

  • AI-native, well beyond using a LLM: you have shipped AI features into production and know how you measured them, you build your own agents or automations, and you prototype in code

  • Product taste: you can show us things you've shaped where the details are right, and tell us what you cut and why

  • Commercial sharpness: you understand how dealers make money and can connect product decisions to their margin and stock turn, and to Carwow revenue

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this is a new vertical, so the role involves defining the problem as much as solving it

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about data pipelines, integrations and architecture

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you\

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive

  • Experience with pricing, valuation or demand-forecasting products

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience launching a new vertical or marketplace category, including GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

Your team

You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about.

Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses.

Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access.

The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly.

Your mission

As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale.

What you will do

Publisher integrations

  • Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers.

  • Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory.

  • Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend.

Deals & catalog

  • Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API.

  • Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe.

  • Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it.

Supply tooling & publisher platform

  • Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend.

  • Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production.

  • Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design.

  • Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow.

  • Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break.

  • Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy.

  • Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables.

  • Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts.

  • Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value.

Nice to have

  • Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST.

  • Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels).

  • Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar).

  • Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description:
Prevention Analyst - Pentesting

About this role


We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next.

That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go.

This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on.

This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end.

What you will do

  • Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective.

  • Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect.

  • Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice.

  • Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact.

  • Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on.

  • Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together.

  • Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients.

What you will need

  • Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications.

  • The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why.

  • Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one.

  • The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy.

  • A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player.

  • Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel.

  • Fluent English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS.

  • A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience.

  • Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats.

  • Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy.

  • Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

About Eye Security


Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally, having secured our Series C funding of 60 million.

We combine cutting edge technology with hands on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission, to make enterprise grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

jobs.title: Solution Consulting Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

The Role

We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team.

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team, primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale.

You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team.

Responsibilities

Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)

  • Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity.

  • Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.

  • Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.

  • Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.

  • Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

Run your own sales cycles (~25%)

  • Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.

  • Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.

  • Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

Inform product and build for scale

  • Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization.

  • Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed.

  • Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths.

  • Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years managing or formally mentoring pre-sales, solutions consulting or sales engineering teams, with a track record of developing people.

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment.

  • Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr.

We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons.

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You'll Do

We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will:

  • Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it.

  • Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following.

  • Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage.

  • Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review.

  • Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified.

  • Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. 

What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role

  •  5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis.

  • Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems.

  • A data-driven mindset: you define metrics, build the tooling to measure them, and use them to argue for or against a change.

  • Experience diagnosing hard-to-reproduce failures: flakiness, platform-specific behavior, memory and threading bugs.

  • Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders.

Would be a Plus

  • Familiarity with navigation concepts (map matching, dead reckoning, route progress, or Electronic Horizon).

  • Experience with replay- or simulation-based testing using real sensor and GPS data.

  • Hands-on experience building AI- or agent-based developer tooling for testing, code review, or triage.

  • Experience with coverage tooling, performance benchmarking, or testing SDKs through generated bindings.


Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

    What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

How We Support You

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth.

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

jobs.description:
Join us in reshaping manufacturing with advanced tech like computer vision and AI!

As a Staff Robotics Engineer – Physical AI (m/f/d), you will be integral in driving our company's next phase of innovation - automating industrial processes to address the scarcity of skilled labor. We have already proven our ability to optimize processes and increase efficiency, and now we are determined to automate tasks within industrial environments. Your main focus will be on R&D and will involve building and showcasing a demonstrator that utilizes industrial robot arms to automate currently manual tasks.

You have a strong background in state of the art in robotic manipulation, extensive experience in modeling, planning, and controlling robotic systems, as well as applying machine learning techniques to enhance robotic manipulation capabilities.

 

Your role

  • Lead R&D efforts to prototype a new robotic manipulator, conducting rigorous testing to validate design specifications and performance criteria.

  • Work with industry-standard hardware platforms (e.g., ROS-compatible robots, specific sensor suites) to develop and deploy robotic manipulators for real world testing.

  • Develop and implement models for hybrid dynamical systems exhibiting both continuous and discrete dynamic behaviors, specifically in robotic manipulators.

  • Design advanced planning algorithms to optimize manipulation tasks such as pick-and-place operations.

  • Experience with supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning techniques to improve manipulation performance in robots.

  • Previously trained RL models in both simulated and real-world environments with continuous action and state spaces.

  • Design and develop middleware and software solutions tailored for robotic manipulation applications.

  • Optimize software architecture for efficient communication between sensors, processors, and actuators in robotic manipulators.

  • Develop perception algorithms for object pose estimation, matching, and instance segmentation to aid in manipulation tasks.

  • Utilize deep learning techniques for end-to-end and self-supervised grasping, enhancing the robot's autonomous manipulation capabilities.

  • Experience with integration between hardware components, including tactile sensors, force sensors, vision systems (e.g., RGB-D cameras), and depth sensors to optimize communication protocols and data flow for efficient robotic operations.

 

Your profile

  • Ph.D. in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, with a strong emphasis on robotics.

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in robotics research or development.

  • Proven experience in modeling, planning, and controlling hybrid dynamical systems for robotic manipulation.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques applied to robotic manipulation tasks.

  • Experience with robotic perception technologies and deep learning frameworks as applied to manipulation.

  • Strong programming skills in C++, Python, and familiarity with ROS (Robot Operating System).

This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts.

You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline.
